verses.original: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις πληθυνόντων τῶν μαθητῶν ἐγένετο γογγυσμὸς τῶν Ἑλληνιστῶν πρὸς τοὺς Ἑβραίους ὅτι παρεθεωροῦντο ἐν τῇ διακονίᾳ τῇ καθημερινῇ αἱ χῆραι αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: En de tais hēmerais tautais plēthynontōn tōn mathētōn egeneto gongysmos tōn Hellēnistōn pros tous Hebraious hoti paretheōrounto en tē diakonia tē kathēmerinē hai chērai autōn
verses.literal: In those days when the disciples were increasing in number the Grecian Jews among them began to grumble against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food
verses.literalPt: ORA, naqueles dias, crescendo o número dos discípulos, houve uma murmuração dos gregos contra os hebreus, porque as suas viúvas eram desprezadas no ministério cotidiano.

verses.original: Προσκαλεσάμενοι δὲ οἱ δώδεκα τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν εἶπαν Οὐκ ἀρεστόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς καταλείψαντας τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ διακονεῖν τραπέζαις
verses.transliteration: Proskalesamenoi de hoi dōdeka to plēthos tōn mathētōn eipan Ouk areston estin hēmas kataleipsantas ton logon tou Theou diakonein trapezais
verses.literal: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables
verses.literalPt: E os doze, convocando a multidão dos discípulos, disseram: Não é razoável que nós deixemos a palavra de Deus e sirvamos às mesas.

verses.original: ἐπισκέψασθε δέ ἀδελφοί ἄνδρας ἐξ ὑμῶν μαρτυρουμένους ἑπτὰ πλήρεις Πνεύματος καὶ σοφίας οὓς καταστήσομεν ἐπὶ τῆς χρείας ταύτης
verses.transliteration: episkepsasthe de adelphoi andras ex hymōn martyroumenous hepta plēreis Pneumatos kai sophias hous katastēsomen epi tēs chreias tautēs
verses.literal: Therefore brothers select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of the Spirit and wisdom We will assign this - responsibility to them
verses.literalPt: Escolhei, pois, irmãos, dentre vós, sete homens de boa reputação, cheios do Espírito Santo e de sabedoria, aos quais constituamos sobre este importante negócio.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ τῇ διακονίᾳ τοῦ λόγου προσκαρτερήσομεν
verses.transliteration: hēmeis de tē proseuchē kai tē diakonia tou logou proskarterēsomen
verses.literal: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word
verses.literalPt: Mas nós perseveraremos na oração e no ministério da palavra.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤρεσεν ὁ λόγος ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ πλήθους καὶ ἐξελέξαντο Στέφανον ἄνδρα πλήρης πίστεως καὶ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου καὶ Φίλιππον καὶ Πρόχορον καὶ Νικάνορα καὶ Τίμωνα καὶ Παρμενᾶν καὶ Νικόλαον προσήλυτον Ἀντιοχέα
verses.transliteration: Kai ēresen ho logos enōpion pantos tou plēthous kai exelexanto Stephanon andra plērēs pisteōs kai Pneumatos Hagiou kai Philippon kai Prochoron kai Nikanora kai Timōna kai Parmenan kai Nikolaon prosēlyton Antiochea
verses.literal: This proposal pleased . . . the whole group They chose Stephen a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit as well as Philip Prochorus Nicanor Timon Parmenas and Nicolas from Antioch a convert to Judaism
verses.literalPt: E este parecer contentou a toda a multidão, e elegeram Estêvão, homem cheio de fé e do Espírito Santo, e Filipe, e Prócoro, e Nicanor, e Timão, e Parmenas e Nicolau, prosélito de Antioquia;

verses.original: οὓς ἔστησαν ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προσευξάμενοι ἐπέθηκαν αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας
verses.transliteration: hous estēsan enōpion tōn apostolōn kai proseuxamenoi epethēkan autois tas cheiras
verses.literal: They presented these seven to the apostles who prayed and laid their hands on them
verses.literalPt: E os apresentaram ante os apóstolos, e estes, orando, lhes impuseram as mãos.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐπληθύνετο ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν μαθητῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ σφόδρα πολύς τε ὄχλος τῶν ἱερέων ὑπήκουον τῇ πίστει
verses.transliteration: Kai ho logos tou Theou ēuxanen kai eplēthyneto ho arithmos tōn mathētōn en Ierousalēm sphodra polys te ochlos tōn hiereōn hypēkouon tē pistei
verses.literal: So the word of God continued to spread The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith
verses.literalPt: E crescia a palavra de Deus, e em Jerusalém se multiplicava muito o número dos discípulos, e grande parte dos sacerdotes obedecia à fé.

verses.original: Στέφανος δὲ πλήρης χάριτος καὶ δυνάμεως ἐποίει τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα μεγάλα ἐν τῷ λαῷ
verses.transliteration: Stephanos de plērēs charitos kai dynameōs epoiei terata kai sēmeia megala en tō laō
verses.literal: Now Stephen who was full of grace and power was performing great wonders and signs among the people
verses.literalPt: E Estêvão, cheio de fé e de poder, fazia prodígios e grandes sinais entre o povo.

verses.original: ἀνέστησαν δέ τινες τῶν ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς τῆς λεγομένης Λιβερτίνων καὶ Κυρηναίων καὶ Ἀλεξανδρέων καὶ τῶν ἀπὸ Κιλικίας καὶ Ἀσίας συζητοῦντες τῷ Στεφάνῳ
verses.transliteration: anestēsan de tines tōn ek tēs synagōgēs tēs legomenēs Libertinōn kai Kyrēnaiōn kai Alexandreōn kai tōn apo Kilikias kai Asias syzētountes tō Stephanō
verses.literal: But resistance arose - from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen including Cyrenians Alexandrians and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia They disputed with Stephen
verses.literalPt: E levantaram-se alguns que eram da sinagoga chamada dos libertinos, e dos cireneus e dos alexandrinos, e dos que eram da Cilícia e da Ásia, e disputavam com Estêvão.

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυον ἀντιστῆναι τῇ σοφίᾳ καὶ τῷ Πνεύματι ᾧ ἐλάλει
verses.transliteration: kai ouk ischyon antistēnai tē sophia kai tō Pneumati hō elalei
verses.literal: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke
verses.literalPt: E não podiam resistir à sabedoria, e ao Espírito com que falava.

verses.original: Τότε ὑπέβαλον ἄνδρας λέγοντας ὅτι Ἀκηκόαμεν αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ῥήματα βλάσφημα εἰς Μωϋσῆν καὶ τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Tote hypebalon andras legontas hoti Akēkoamen autou lalountos rhēmata blasphēma eis Mōusēn kai ton Theon
verses.literal: Then they prompted some men to say We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God
verses.literalPt: Então subornaram uns homens, para que dissessem: Ouvimos-lhe proferir palavras blasfemas contra Moisés e contra Deus.

verses.original: συνεκίνησάν τε τὸν λαὸν καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς καὶ ἐπιστάντες συνήρπασαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἤγαγον εἰς τὸ συνέδριον
verses.transliteration: synekinēsan te ton laon kai tous presbyterous kai tous grammateis kai epistantes synērpasan auton kai ēgagon eis to synedrion
verses.literal: So they stirred up the people - elders and scribes and confronted Stephen They seized him and brought him before the Sanhedrin
verses.literalPt: E excitaram o povo, os anciãos e os escribas; e, investindo contra ele, o arrebataram e o levaram ao conselho.

verses.original: Ἔστησάν τε μάρτυρας ψευδεῖς λέγοντας Ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος οὐ παύεται λαλῶν ῥήματα κατὰ τοῦ τόπου τοῦ ἁγίου τούτου καὶ τοῦ νόμου
verses.transliteration: Estēsan te martyras pseudeis legontas Ho anthrōpos houtos ou pauetai lalōn rhēmata kata tou topou tou hagiou toutou kai tou nomou
verses.literal: where they presented false witnesses who said This man never stops speaking . . . against this holy place and against the law
verses.literalPt: E apresentaram falsas testemunhas, que diziam: Este homem não cessa de proferir palavras blasfemas contra este santo lugar e a lei;

verses.original: ἀκηκόαμεν γὰρ αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος οὗτος καταλύσει τὸν τόπον τοῦτον καὶ ἀλλάξει τὰ ἔθη ἃ παρέδωκεν ἡμῖν Μωϋσῆς
verses.transliteration: akēkoamen gar autou legontos hoti Iēsous ho Nazōraios houtos katalysei ton topon touton kai allaxei ta ethē ha paredōken hēmin Mōusēs
verses.literal: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us
verses.literalPt: Porque nós lhe ouvimos dizer que esse Jesus Nazareno há de destruir este lugar e mudar os costumes que Moisés nos deu.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀτενίσαντες εἰς αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ καθεζόμενοι ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ εἶδον τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ πρόσωπον ἀγγέλου
verses.transliteration: Kai atenisantes eis auton pantes hoi kathezomenoi en tō synedriō eidon to prosōpon autou hōsei prosōpon angelou
verses.literal: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel
verses.literalPt: Então todos os que estavam assentados no conselho, fixando os olhos nele, viram o seu rosto como o rosto de um anjo.
